packageRules.description: Helmetica dev tags are sorted numerically. Semver would read v0.1.0-dev9 as newer than v0.1.0-dev21. Grouping keeps the crd/default refs and the image tag of a component on the same version. allowedVersions drops the per-arch tags the release workflow pushes next to each release: loose compares the part after the version numbers as a string, so v0.1.0-dev21-arm64 reads as newer than v0.1.0-dev21, and a bump to it would pin every node to one architecture.

customManagers.description: Update versions in Justfiles annotated with a `# renovate:` comment
Update the just version used to bootstrap the devcontainer and CI

custos passes its own image to the gather Job as a flag. It sits inside a kustomize patch, where neither the kustomize nor the kubernetes manager looks, so without this it would keep pointing at the previous release after a bump. hearth/helmetica/** puts it in the helmetica group with the component's other refs.
